tellYourBarber.haircut:crop--soft-french-crop-scissor-s: Please do a soft French crop with textured fringe and keep the sides fuller rather than too tight.
tellYourBarber.haircut:side-part--soft-side-part: I'd like a soft side part with natural movement, some width at the sides, and not too much height on top.
tellYourBarber.haircut:fringe--messy-fringe: I'd like a messy fringe, but keep the front light and broken with some fullness at the sides.
tellYourBarber.haircut:asian-fringe--asian-textured-cro: I want an Asian textured crop with a soft choppy fringe and a clean low taper.
tellYourBarber.haircut:crew--ivy-league: I want an Ivy League with a soft side part and not too much height through the front.
tellYourBarber.haircut:side-part--classic-side-part: I'd like a classic side part with neat sides and a natural sweep across the top.
tellYourBarber.haircut:taper--tapered-neckline: Please keep it classic with a tapered neckline, tidy around the back, and a natural side flow on top.
tellYourBarber.haircut:male_tousled_cut: Give me a textured fringe with piecey movement, but keep the crown controlled and the overall shape low.
tellYourBarber.haircut:curtains--short-curtains-low-tap: I'd like short curtains with a subtle split, kept fairly narrow through the front and not too much height.
tellYourBarber.haircut:crop--side-swept-textured-crop: I'd like a side-swept textured crop that follows my natural part and stays compact through the front.
tellYourBarber.haircut:fringe--choppy-fringe: I want a choppy fringe with soft broken pieces and a lighter front, not a thick blunt fringe.
tellYourBarber.haircut:side-part--side-part-fade: I want a side part fade, but keep it soft and leave some weight through the upper sides.
tellYourBarber.haircut:taper--low-taper-fade: Give me a low taper fade, but keep some width at the sides and don't build too much height on top.
tellYourBarber.haircut:two-block--korean-two-block-curt: I want a Korean two-block, but keep the curtain lower and the sides softer so it doesn't look too disconnected.
